title: プログラミングⅠ
subtitle: Programming I
educationalGoal: "Control structure" and "function" are important and indispensable elements in programming. In this course, students learn the usage of "conditional branch", "loop" and "function" and practice them in actual program.
advice: The concepts of "conditional branch", "loop" and "functions" learned in this course play an important role in almost all programming languages, not just C language. Therefore, I would like you to take this course with the intention of learning "general programming" rather than "C language".
books: Textbook: 明快入門C スーパー ビギナー編 [SBクリエイティブ]
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to understand and master the contents of the introduction to programming.

activityGoals.body: Be able to make conditional expressions.
Be able to use conditional branch by "if" and "switch".
Be able to use loop by "for" and "while".
Be able to use functions understanding the mechanism of them.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
